title: 低壓化學氣相沉積
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究熱反應與低壓、批次與均勻性、材料與膜性、整合與品質；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: thermal reaction and low pressure, batch and uniformity, materials and film properties, integration and quality. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

stages.descriptionEn: LPCVD rate is jointly constrained by surface reactions and gas transport.

steps.title: 畫出進氣、熱區與排氣的流程

steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：氣體歷程會影響基板反應。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Gas history affects substrate reaction.

steps.instructionEn: Draw inlet, heated zone and exhaust. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Gas history affects substrate reaction.
steps.observation: 氣體歷程會影響基板反應。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
steps.observationEn: Gas history affects substrate reaction. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Lower pressure necessarily increases every deposition rate.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check: 交付「畫出進氣、熱區與排氣的流程」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「氣體歷程會影響基板反應。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the diagram, table or calculation for "Draw inlet, heated zone and exhaust", with sources, assumptions and units. Identify evidence supporting "Gas history affects substrate reaction." and retain one limitation.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜接班建模：先寫出不能推論的事
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Shift intake: state what the evidence cannot prove
knowledge.text:
以「低壓化學氣相沉積」為本次任務邊界，閱讀「畫出進氣、熱區與排氣的流程」後，先列出輸入、輸出與量測單位。特別檢查：批次平均厚度會隱藏晶舟位置與徑向差異。將已知、模型假設與未量測項目分開，再進入「電漿與薄膜：深度、覆蓋與端點」整合遊戲。

需留下的證據：任務邊界表：低壓化學氣相沉積 的資料版本、單位、輸入／輸出及一項不能由現有證據支持的結論。

驗證與交接：能用自己的話解釋為何「批次平均厚度會隱藏晶舟位置與徑向差異」，且沒有把猜測寫成實測。
knowledge.textEn:
Use Low-pressure chemical vapor deposition as the task boundary. After reading “Draw inlet, heated zone and exhaust”, list inputs, outputs and measurement units. Check specifically: Batch mean thickness can hide boat-position and radial differences. Separate known data, model assumptions and unmeasured items before entering “Plasma and films: depth, coverage and endpoint”.

Evidence to retain: Boundary sheet for Low-pressure chemical vapor deposition: data version, units, inputs/outputs and one unsupported conclusion.

Verification and handover: Explain why “Batch mean thickness can hide boat-position and radial differences” and do not present assumptions as measurements.

quiz.question: 完成「畫出進氣、熱區與排氣的流程」後，哪項判讀可靠？
quiz.questionEn: After "Draw inlet, heated zone and exhaust", which interpretation is defensible?
options: 氣體歷程會影響基板反應。
降低壓力必定增加所有材料的沉積速率。
同一批次所有位置自然完全相同。
optionsEn: Lower pressure necessarily increases every deposition rate.
Every batch position is inherently identical.
quiz.explanation: 氣體歷程會影響基板反應。 LPCVD 的速率受表面反應與氣體輸運共同限制。
quiz.explanationEn: Gas history affects substrate reaction. LPCVD rate is jointly constrained by surface reactions and gas transport.
